title: Tenant routing contracts + automated evidence bundles for hosted API
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Build a tenant-focused feature set that lets legal/compliance teams define a binding routing contract for Hosted API traffic and automatically generate time-stamped, tamper-evident evidence bundles for audits. The feature combines per-tenant routing rules (region preferences, hard pins, soft preferences with fallback) with retention enforcement and a scheduled evidence export pipeline that produces compliance-ready artifacts (signed manifests, request-level metadata, and storage residency proofs).
background: Customers increasingly require a single place to declare contractual data residency obligations and receive packaged proof of compliance on a schedule. Existing work covers region routing controls and ad-hoc audit exports, but there is no end-to-end UX and automation for: (1) binding tenant routing contracts, (2) deterministic fallback handling when pinned regions are unavailable, (3) retention enforcement tied to contracts, and (4) scheduled, signed evidence bundles usable in audits.
goals: Provide a concise console workflow for legal/ops to create a Tenant Routing Contract that encodes preferred regions, hard pins, retention windows, and fallback policies.
Enforce retention windows at ingest and provide retention metadata in exports.
Produce automated evidence bundles on a configurable cadence (daily/weekly/monthly) containing signed manifests, per-request region evaluations, and storage residency proofs.
Expose APIs so partners can retrieve contract metadata and evidence bundles programmatically.
Fail fast and surface clear operator/tenant-visible diagnostics when routing falls back to non-preferred regions.
Minimize performance regression and avoid impacting SLOs for non-affected tenants.
proposed_solution: Add a Console flow and corresponding Hosted API config object: TenantRoutingContract. The contract includes: region_preferences (ordered list), pin_mode (hard | soft), fallback_policy (alternate-region | queue | reject), retention_days, evidence_schedule (cron-like presets), and signing_profile. Implement: 1) API validation to attach contracts to tenant metadata, 2) router layer checks to evaluate contract on each request and record decision logs, 3) retention enforcement hooks that tag stored payloads with contract IDs and TTLs, and 4) an Evidence Worker that compiles logs, storage proofs, and signs a manifest with the customer's signing_profile. Evidence bundles are stored in a tenant-visible secure bucket and surfaced in the Console and API with HMAC-signed URLs.
acceptance_criteria: Console: create/edit/delete Tenant Routing Contract with validation and tooltips for legal terms.
API: tenant_contracts endpoints for CRUD and list; API keys can query assigned contract for a tenant.
Routing: 99% of requests for tenants with hard pins are routed to pinned region when capacity exists; when fallback occurs, a clear diagnostic code is emitted in the request trace and audit log.
Retention: all stored artifacts for a tenant are labeled with TTL derived from the contract; retention enforcement removes data after TTL and logs deletion events.

Evidence bundles: automated bundles generated at scheduled cadence, include signed manifest, per-request region decision list, storage residency verification, and a checksum; bundle generation success/failure metrics available in Console.
Security: evidence bundles are signed per signing_profile; only tenant admins and authorized audit roles can retrieve bundles.
Performance: feature rollout does not increase median request latency by more than 5% for affected tenants and has no measurable impact on unrelated tenants.
rollout_plan: Phase 1 (Alpha): backend contract storage, router hooks, and basic evidence worker. Internal alpha with 2 partners. (ENG-2307)
Phase 2 (Beta): Console UI, API endpoints, retention enforcement, and signed bundles. Beta customers onboarded with opt-in. (ENG-2510)
Phase 3 (GA): default availability, telemetry dashboards, and automation for scheduled evidence delivery. Add audit-log retention analytics and SLA docs.
Canary strategy: start with <1% of tenants behind flag, expand by usage and stability metrics.
risks_mitigation: Risk: hard pins could increase tail latency or cause request rejections. Mitigation: soft-pin mode and capacity-aware routing; provide clear operator runbooks.
Risk: evidence bundles may contain sensitive PII. Mitigation: redact fields according to tenant-configured redact rules and encrypt bundles at rest.
Risk: inaccurate residency proof. Mitigation: implement storage attestation (region-aware object metadata + signed manifests) and include chain-of-custody logs in bundle.
Risk: regulatory/legal ambiguity for retention defaults. Mitigation: add prominent legal copy and require tenant admin acknowledgement for contract creation.
notes: Design should follow existing Console patterns for org-scoped settings but include an explicit signing UI for legal teams.
We should reuse the existing evidence export format from PM-4389 where practical but add deterministic manifest signing and TTL metadata.
Estimate assumes ENG-2307 (router performance improvements) lands first.
